svg.title: 04 Delete by identity or sweep expired workers
svg.desc: Detailed execution call cards in reading order. Each card shows inputs, transformations and persistence. Dashed cards are assumed connections. Branches and alternatives are explicitly labeled. Read the linked Markdown for all field contracts and errors.
svg.text: 04 Delete by identity or sweep expired workers
White outline = implemented function / AWS configuration • Dashed orange = assumed adapter
Read numbered cards in order; follow the explicit branch labels. Full field and failure contracts are in 04-termination.md.

g.text: T1 ASSUMED timeout adapter → deleteInstance
PARSE authenticated envelope; check timeout event
SELECT detail.deliveryId; no caller-supplied instance ID
CALL await EC2Service.deleteInstance(deliveryId)
NOTE service itself does not validate expiry
T2 deleteInstance: validate table → get journal
CALL InstanceJournal.get with consistent read
CHOOSE savedInstanceResource OR await findInstance
NONE / OBSERVED TERMINATED return without termination
SAVED ID bypasses discovery; status is unknown
T3 Explicit deletion → record → return
SEND TerminateInstances InstanceIds=[resourceId]
ADD status termination_requested; local timestamps
STORE record writes only instanceId; not lifecycle fields
ERROR record can fail after AWS accepts termination
C1 Alternative: recurring cleanup schedule
DEFAULT every minute; group agentic-cleanups
PUBLISH {} to cleanup bus with CleanupRequested
RULE agentic.setup + CleanupRequested → /cleanup
AUTH API key; body and caller selectors are ignored
C2 handleCleanup → cleanupExpiredInstances
CHECK API key, fixed region and requests table
INIT result arrays; seen IDs; EC2 client; NextToken
QUERY ManagedBy=agentic-setup; five live/stopped states
LOOP every page; flatten reservations and instances
C3 Deduplicate IDs → expiredInstanceTags
MISSING / SEEN ID ignore; else add to seen
TAGS Object.fromEntries; test ownership and identity
REQUIRE UTC-shaped parseable deadline <= now
REJECT missing tags / future / terminated → skipped
C4 cleanupInstance: fresh ID-specific recheck
SEND DescribeInstances InstanceIds=[id]
FIND matching instance; rerun expiredInstanceTags
CHANGED / MISSING / INELIGIBLE append skipped; return
VALID {deliveryId, timeoutAt, token} from fresh tags
C5 Tracking read does not block orphan deletion
CALL InstanceJournal.get(ownership.deliveryId, table)
MATCH journal deliveryId and token to tags
FAILURE append trackingFailed; still continue
NOTE saved instanceId is not compared to candidate
C6 Terminate expired instance
SEND TerminateInstances InstanceIds=[id]
SUCCESS append terminationRequested
FAILURE outer per-instance catch appends failed
CONTINUE other candidates and remaining pages
C7 Matching journal only: map and record
CALL instanceResource(current, ownership, token, time)
OVERRIDE status; add terminationRequestedAt
STORE resourceLaunch.instanceId only
WRITE FAILURE append trackingFailed; keep accepted ID
C8 Sweep response → endpoint status
RETURN terminationRequested / skipped / failed / trackingFailed
LOG array counts; arrays can overlap
HTTP 500 if failed or trackingFailed; otherwise 200
PAGE ERROR generic 500; earlier actions may remain
T4 Common AWS terminal boundary
AWS termination acceptance → shutting-down → terminated
DELETE configured root disk; primary ENI lifecycle
NO application waiter or attachment deletion check
RETAIN request journal; no persisted terminal status
